scope: Only reached functions accepted; complete original output frozen before reconstruction. Typed full indexed tables include named trapping targets for all other valid indexes. No dynamic coverage claimed for unused table branches.

timing.sample: single final suite, no builds included in fixture time
timing.other_batches: Fresh frontier timings below; first/second canonical audit and individual native per-function build durations unmeasured; later audited batches have separate evidence timings. No aggregate total is invented.

body_accounting.method: The old Ghidra inventory remains partial. The disassembler CFG supplement resolves all internal jumps, follows both conditional edges and call fallthrough, and proves its skipped extent bytes are the original alignment templates. This is static instruction accounting, not dynamic branch coverage.

components.name: unclassified: uninventoried bodies, inline data and padding

experience: Native i386 GDB kept meaningful symbols and the224-byte typed decoder state accessible at every new entry;54 scalar words plus pointer nullness/relative ModRM cursor and actual bytes matched where the original diagnostic could sample the state. Full output exposed and preserved native decoder quirks rather than replacing them with architectural expectations. No shared shim change was required. Canonical Win32 compilation and graph/data/extent/ABI audits remain separate explicit diagnostics. Unexercised lookup targets retain named INT3 stubs.
